title: HYROX LADDER
why: You're fully recharged and want intensity, so today goes hard: a heavy double-bell couplet while you're fresh (longer rest for strength quality), then a HYROX-style descending ladder blended with treadmill runs for the engine, capped by a 40/20 swing finisher (2:1 work:rest, the sweet spot for fat-loss bursts). Uses every tool you own.

blocks.title: WARM-UP
blocks.text: Brisk treadmill walk 2 min · Halos 5/side · Body-pass 5/side · Goblet pry ×5 · Leg swings 10/leg · Shoulder dislocates ×10 · Ankle rocks 10/side · 10 priming swings (16 kg).

blocks.title: HEAVY COUPLET
blocks.text: Do 5 front squats straight into 5 push press, no rest between the two. Then rest 75s. That's 1 round. Crisp reps, stop 1–2 short of failure. This is your strength hit while fresh.

blocks.title: HYROX LADDER
blocks.text: Round 1: 15 clean & press + 15 goblet squats, then run 0.20 mi hard. Round 2: 12 + 12, then run. Round 3: 9 + 9, then run. Go for time, rest only as needed. This is the engine.

blocks.title: SWING FINISHER
blocks.text: 4 rounds: 40 seconds of powerful swings, 20 seconds rest. Snap hard, stop the round if form softens. Empty the tank.

blocks.title: COOLDOWN
blocks.text: Walk it down 1–2 min · Stretch 20–30s each: hip flexors, hamstrings, chest/shoulders, spinal twist.
